reviews.reviewtitle: BUTTON OFF MY SHIRT + The Monroes
reviews.reviewbody:
Surely That Song Was Rec. 1st by Mr. Milsap,
while he topped the U.S. Hot Country Charts with
his (amazing 32nd #1) cover hit: "Snap Your Fingers"
already in MAY 1987 & that was taken from his "Heart & Soul' Album where 'Button Off My Shirt' Is. 

Englishman Mr. Carrack Rel. His Rendition not until
The 1st of November 1987.

Apparently, it looks pretty odd the fact that the song was co-written by The Scotsman Graham Lyle (Gallagher & Lyle) and maybe should've stayed first at the British Kingdom & rec. by Carrack & not vice versa: Graham & Then Paul.
But, as we all know, Lyle's Songs Have sung hugely in The U.S. by many of the best.
Rather Than This, His Partner For that song Was American - Prolific Billy Livsey.

BTW, Lyle Himself Rec. 'Button Off My Shirt' in His 2003 Album: 'Something Beautiful Remains'.

The Monroes:
Happy Belated Birthday to Jesus Tony Ortiz!
Good Luck with The Guns Of Soul.
Ron, You took me back re-listening to your show-interview with Ortiz. one of the shows in 2011.
In fact, It was only 2 years before their surprising release of a Mini Album of a supposed 2nd album.
All Songs Rec. Back Then in the Happy 80's.
A Confession. These songs sound even better than some of the Orig. EP's stuff.
Especially Go Listen to: 'Stones Against The Rain' & 'Safe As Fire' that should've been Hits. sound like ones, smell like ones.
the Cold Fact: Alfa Label Went Down In The U.S..
so be it.
but RCA oh boy, they've made a Hugh mistake with not promoting The Monroes new material at that time.

The 2013 Release Contains & Reveals that
'What Do All The People Know' in fact has 3 different
Edits.
7'' single 03:30min long.
EP version 04:03min long.
2013 release (yet, rec. circa '82)  04:20min long. with extra lyrics to it.
Label Alfa's best bunny was the Jap Synth-pop band: 'Yellow Magic Orchestra'.
Ortiz Told In 2 Interviews I've listened to (Ron's & another) that he recorded 'Ticket to Ride' when a young teen.
Yellow magic has a cool hip for it's time version to 'Day Tripper' dated 1979.
